known_gaps.description: Fifteen deterministic sanitized derivative candidates are hash-pinned but require direct visual review before model input approval.
Eight benchmark cases require primary-figure segmentation. SAM2 prompt seeds and wrapper exist, but outputs require a capable local SAM2 environment and visual approval.
The current 27 cases are concentrated in Hulk, Venom, and Thing character corpora and do not yet test many official/specialized architecture families.
The 744 high-priority source->LEGO pairs are batched and reviewable, but canonical supervision still requires submitted reviews, second reviews where needed, and explicit adjudication.
Exact rear/side/physical evidence remains limited and must not be synthesized.
Lower- versus upper-torso segment length remains underidentified until additional chest/torso-center landmarks are added.
